correctness.rationale: The full proof derives Poisson means Ku and K(L-u) at fixed physical cutoff and differentiates them with respect to both K and c. Its exact Schur complement is a positive between-bin variance. Exponential-score centroid derivatives reduce global maximization to the unique zero of a strictly increasing difference A(u)-B(L-u). Positive derivative numerators, endpoint inequalities and the half-interval sign establish existence, uniqueness and exact scope. Monotone bounding yields e^u=1+2u at infinite horizon, and direct unbinned score integration proves the 81.4528755% and 75% information-retention limits. The shipped independent-formula verifier passed 2,200 seeded parameter settings; numerical checks support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The scientifically natural resource constraint is retaining two event counts rather than exact aftershock times while estimating an early-time Omori offset with unknown productivity. This is a nontrivial local Fisher experimental-design question in which a poor cutoff destroys information. The globally optimal one-dimensional monotone design rule proves the early window stays at 2.51286 offset scales even for unbounded monitoring, and quantifies the precise 81.45% limiting fraction of full timestamp information; these are usable sharp cutoffs, not a routine data-table recomputation. The model assumptions and untested empirical applicability are explicit.
